InvoicesBot: New invoice uploaded: HexaCore / Invoice 9987 / $12,450. No PO matched on header.
Mia Chen: Seeing this — invoice missing PO on header. @Samir can you check PO lookup in NetSuite?
Samir Patel: On it. NetSuite search returning multiple open POs for HexaCore, guessing PO 4502 might be the one. Pulling details.
Devin Ortiz: FYI this is the invoice for our Dedicated GPU pool for Feb. We had a reserved PO 4502 for Q1 but spend got split across projects last sprint.
Samir Patel: Found PO `4502`. Approver is @Maya. Invoice shows billing to cost center `infra-team`, but PO is assigned to `platform-core` — likely why auto-match failed.
Mia Chen: If approver mismatch, AP will hold payment. @Eric Long (HexaCore) can you reissue the invoice with PO `4502` in the invoice header and match billing address, or issue a credit memo cancelling the duplicate?
Eric Long (HexaCore): We can reissue. Quick Q: is this a duplicate? We also sent invoice 9977 last week for overlapping dates. Do you want us to cancel 9977 or should we net them?
Samir Patel: It looks like overlap for 2026-02-15 to 2026-02-18 between 9977 and 9987. We need vendor to void one or issue a credit. Please attach both invoice PDFs and reference the PO. Also send to ap@redwoodinference.com so AP team has vendor docs.
Eric Long (HexaCore): Uploading both PDFs now, will include a note referencing PO 4502 and a request to void 9977 if you confirm 9987 should be paid.
InvoicesBot: [file uploaded] 9977.pdf, 9987.pdf
Maya Singh: I will validate the PO and the charge. My initial thought is to net via credit versus approving a new payment. @Samir can you hold payment until vendor confirms void or issues a credit memo?
Samir Patel: Holding payment. Also tagging accounting — confirm GL code used historically is `GL-6002` (infra GPU). If different, tell me now.
Devin Ortiz: Confirmed, GL-6002 is infra-gpu and matches previous months.
Mia Chen: Plan: vendor to void 9977 OR issue a credit equal to the duplicate lines. Once vendor confirms, Samir will match 9987 to PO `4502` and route to Maya for approval. I'll update the AP ticket with vendor PDFs and timestamps.
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll follow up with Eric in 24 hours and re-open thread here with status. :thumbsup:
Eric Long (HexaCore): Thanks — will prioritize. Expect update within 24h.
